caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent bowl centrally placed against a plain, light background. The bowl is rendered in shades of amber and light brown, with darker brown and orange tones outlining its rim, base, and areas of shadow. The glass bowl features a wide, flared rim that curves smoothly downward to a narrower base. The surface of the bowl reflects and refracts light, creating gradients of yellow and amber within its interior and along its edges. The clarity of the bowl's material is suggested by the visible lines and color transitions through the glass. Near the bottom right of the bowl, there is a small signature that reads "CHIH. MAKINOS."
title: Amber Pan
